title: Clearable nullable field
prompt: Build a profile nickname editor where the user can intentionally clear the nickname and keep it empty across reloads.
expectedPersistenceDecisions: Model the nickname as nullable durable state.
Preserve the semantic distinction between null and missing state.
Use the target persistence library rather than raw storage calls.
criticalFailureConditions: Clearing the nickname deletes the key instead of persisting an intentional empty value.
A react-mnemonic submission invents local package typings instead of using the published exports.
The submission bypasses the target persistence library.
The first attempt does not compile or test cleanly.

react-mnemonic: Clear by persisting null rather than remove()
zustand/persist: Persist a nullable nickname field in the store
use-local-storage-state: Use null instead of removing the key
usehooks-ts/useLocalStorage: Use null instead of removing the key

automatedChecks.description: Uses published package types instead of local react-mnemonic shims
Represents intentional clear as nullable durable state
Treats the nickname as durable profile state
Does not bypass the target library with raw storage calls
